> x : Int
> -- TYPE MISMATCH ---------------------------------------- <repl>

fango's (/) only works on Float, but this operand is:

    Int

1| x / 2
   ^

Note: there is no automatic Int-to-Float conversion — use a
Float value here, like `2.0` instead of `2`.
> -- PRINT NOT ALLOWED HERE ------------------------------- <repl>

For now, only `main` can print — `print` inside other
definitions arrives with effects (S7).

1| x = print 1
       ^^^^^
> -2 : Int
> | | "b" : String
>
